subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is scheduler-boundary proof plus the skipped Mantis internal-path manifest sufficient for this draft PR, or must the contributor provide a live gateway/Telegram proof artifact before merge?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but this external PR lacks an after-fix real behavior artifact that shows the changed delivery path in a real channel; only a maintainer can accept that proof gap for an internal failure mode.

options.title: Require Combined Live Proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97448 or an equivalent proof hook shows baseline missing or blocking the generated media and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Boundary Proof
options.body: Allow the PR to proceed based on the focused scheduler tests and the Mantis manifest's internal fixed=true signal, while owning the lack of visible channel evidence.

options.title: Pause For Harness Direction
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97308 or another maintainer-approved harness path before deciding this implementation PR.

recommendation.title: Require Combined Live Proof
